info.title: acut WMS
info.summary: Official REST API for acut fulfillment WMS
info.description:
### Endpoint
The base url for every endpoint is https://api.wms.acut-services.de/v1

### Authorization & security

Because you can access private data with the Acut WMS API, every request has to be sent over https and must

- Contain a valid API Key identifying the application/developer. It has to be sent as the HTTP header X-ACUT-API-KEY
- Contain a valid user login with acut username and password in form of a basic auth HTTP header

### Throttling

Each API Key has a limit of 60 calls per minute.

get.description:
Get orders

Valid values for current_status

- 1: open (offen)
- 2: progress (in Bearbeitung)
- 3: sent (versendet)
- 13: cancelled (storniert)
- 14: returned (retourniert)
- 25: clarification (in Klärung)
- 28: consolidated (konsolidiert)
- 29: import failed (Import fehlgeschlagen)
- 30: hold (Warte auf Feedback)
- 41: shipping failed (Versand fehlgeschlagen)
- 42: unpaid (unbezahlt)

parameters.name: current_status
parameters.description: List of ids for current status

Example 1.message: Order with ext id "TEST4" already exists
